qe: In which present-day state was Mahatma Gandhi born?
qh: महात्मा गांधी का जन्म वर्तमान भारत के किस राज्य में हुआ था?
e: Mahatma Gandhi was born in Porbandar, which is in present-day Gujarat.

qe: Which Indian city is widely known for its silk industry?
qh: कौन-सा भारतीय शहर अपने रेशम उद्योग के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Bhagalpur in Bihar is widely known for silk and is often called the Silk City.

qe: Which major river flows along Patna?
qh: पटना के पास कौन-सी प्रमुख नदी बहती है?
e: The Ganga flows along the northern edge of Patna.

qe: On which date is Republic Day celebrated in India?
qh: भारत में गणतंत्र दिवस किस तारीख को मनाया जाता है?
e: India celebrates Republic Day on 26 January each year.

qe: Which state lies directly to the south of Bihar?
qh: बिहार के ठीक दक्षिण में कौन-सा राज्य स्थित है?
e: Jharkhand shares Bihar's southern boundary.

qe: Which planet is nearest to the Sun?
qh: सूर्य के सबसे निकट कौन-सा ग्रह है?
e: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.

qe: On which planet do we live?
qh: हम किस ग्रह पर रहते हैं?
e: We live on Earth, the third planet from the Sun.

qe: Which food group is a good source of protein?
qh: कौन-सा खाद्य समूह प्रोटीन का अच्छा स्रोत है?
e: Pulses such as lentils and beans provide protein.

qe: Sunlight helps the human body make which vitamin?
qh: सूर्य का प्रकाश मानव शरीर को कौन-सा विटामिन बनाने में मदद करता है?
e: Sunlight enables the skin to make vitamin D.

qe: What is the path followed by Earth as it moves around the Sun called?
qh: सूर्य के चारों ओर घूमते समय पृथ्वी जिस मार्ग पर चलती है, उसे क्या कहते हैं?
e: The path of a planet around the Sun is its orbit.

qe: How many months are there in one year?
qh: एक वर्ष में कितने महीने होते हैं?
e: A year has twelve months.

qe: How many minutes are there in one hour?
qh: एक घंटे में कितने मिनट होते हैं?
e: One hour contains 60 minutes.

qe: How many millimetres make one centimetre?
qh: एक सेंटीमीटर में कितने मिलीमीटर होते हैं?
e: One centimetre equals 10 millimetres.

qe: What is 25 + 17?
e: 25 plus 17 equals 42.

qe: What is 5 × 8?
qh: 5 × 8 कितना होता है?
e: Five groups of eight make 40.

qe: Which of these is an odd number?
qh: इनमें से कौन-सी विषम संख्या है?
e: 13 is not divisible by 2, so it is an odd number.

qe: How many equal sides does a square have?
qh: वर्ग की कितनी बराबर भुजाएँ होती हैं?
e: A square has four equal sides.

qe: In which direction does the north end of a compass needle point?
qh: कंपास की सुई का उत्तरी सिरा किस दिशा की ओर संकेत करता है?
e: A compass needle aligns approximately with the north-south direction; its north end points north.

qe: What does healthy soil help plants do?
qh: स्वस्थ मिट्टी पौधों को क्या करने में मदद करती है?
oe: Grow by providing support and nutrients
oh: सहारा और पोषक तत्व पाकर बढ़ना
e: Healthy soil provides roots with support, water and nutrients.

qe: In a food chain, green plants are usually called what?
qh: खाद्य शृंखला में हरे पौधों को सामान्यतः क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Green plants make their own food, so they are producers in a food chain.

qe: Which organs help most fish take oxygen from water?
qh: अधिकांश मछलियाँ पानी से ऑक्सीजन लेने के लिए किस अंग का उपयोग करती हैं?
e: Most fish use gills to take oxygen from water.

qe: Which choice best describes a balanced diet?
qh: संतुलित आहार का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन कौन-सा है?
oe: A variety of foods that provide needed nutrients
Only one kind of food every day
oh: ज़रूरी पोषक तत्व देने वाले विविध खाद्य पदार्थ
हर दिन केवल एक प्रकार का भोजन
e: A balanced diet includes a suitable variety of foods and nutrients.

qe: Where should perishable food usually be kept to slow spoilage?
qh: जल्दी खराब होने वाले भोजन को खराब होने से बचाने के लिए सामान्यतः कहाँ रखना चाहिए?
e: Keeping many perishable foods cold in a refrigerator slows the growth of spoilage microbes.

qe: What form of energy makes an electric bulb glow?
qh: बिजली के बल्ब को चमकाने वाली ऊर्जा का रूप क्या है?
e: An electric bulb uses electrical energy and produces light.

qe: A seesaw is an example of which simple machine?
qh: सी-सॉ किस सरल मशीन का उदाहरण है?
e: A seesaw works as a lever that pivots around a central support.

qe: What is the title of India's national anthem?
qh: भारत के राष्ट्रगान का शीर्षक क्या है?
e: 'Jana Gana Mana' is India's national anthem; 'Vande Mataram' is the national song.

qe: What do farmers mainly grow in fields?
qh: किसान खेतों में मुख्य रूप से क्या उगाते हैं?
e: Farmers grow crops such as rice, wheat, pulses and vegetables.

qe: Which item helps us see dates and days of a month?
qh: किस वस्तु से हम महीने की तारीखें और दिन देख सकते हैं?
e: A calendar shows days, dates, weeks and months.

qe: In which broad part of India is Bihar located?
qh: भारत के किस व्यापक भाग में बिहार स्थित है?
e: Bihar is located in eastern India.

qe: Where should household waste be placed instead of being littered in public?
qh: सार्वजनिक स्थान पर कचरा फैलाने के बजाय घरेलू कचरा कहाँ डालना चाहिए?
oe: A dustbin or proper waste collection point
e: Using a dustbin or waste collection point keeps public areas cleaner.
